rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_with_country AS (
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.acronym,
  i.short_name,
  c.unics_id AS country_id,
  c.country_name,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  i.website,
  NULLIF(i.short_name, '')::text AS city  -- lift city-like literal out; use short_name as fallback for city when city not stored
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON c.unics_id = i.country_id
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  institutions_name,
  acronym,
  short_name,
  country_id,
  country_name,
  geocode_regions_3,
  website,
  city
FROM institutions_with_country
WHERE geocode_regions_3 ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'
   OR institutions_name ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'
   OR short_name ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'

rows.question: Find all different topics of projects that ended in 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH topics_dimension AS (
  SELECT
    t.code AS code,
    t.title AS title,
    t.rcn AS rcn
  FROM topics t
),
projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    start_date,
    end_date
  FROM projects
),
project_topics_link AS (
  SELECT
    project AS project,
    topic AS topic
  FROM project_topics
)
SELECT DISTINCT td.code AS topic_code,
       td.title AS topic_title
FROM projects_core pr
JOIN project_topics_link ptl ON ptl.project = pr.unics_id
JOIN topics_dimension td ON td.code = ptl.topic
WHERE pr.end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.end_date) = 2014
ORDER BY td.code

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id
FROM
  projects p
JOIN (
  SELECT
    pm.project,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.unics_id) AS distinct_member_count
  FROM
    project_members pm
  WHERE
    pm.project IS NOT NULL
    AND pm.unics_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    pm.project
) pmc
  ON p.unics_id = pmc.project
WHERE
  pmc.distinct_member_count >= 100

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS code,
  f.title
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ec_fund_scheme IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN trim(ec_fund_scheme) = '' THEN ''
      WHEN lower(ec_fund_scheme) IN ('cp', 'coordinated project', 'coordinated') THEN 'coordinated_project'
      WHEN lower(ec_fund_scheme) IN ('ia', 'innovation action', 'innovation') THEN 'innovation_action'
      WHEN lower(ec_fund_scheme) IN ('ra', 'research action', 'research') THEN 'research_action'
      WHEN lower(ec_fund_scheme) IN ('sa', 'support action', 'support') THEN 'support_action'
      ELSE trim(ec_fund_scheme)
    END AS ec_fund_scheme,
    unics_id
  FROM projects
) p
JOIN funding_schemes f
  ON f.code = p.ec_fund_scheme
WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ec_fund_scheme <> ''
GROUP BY p.ec_fund_scheme, f.title
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.unics_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year
  FROM projects
),
projects_with_valid_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM projects_core p
  WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  (end_year - start_year) AS duration_years
FROM projects_with_valid_years
WHERE (end_year - start_year) = (
  SELECT MAX(end_year - start_year) FROM projects_with_valid_years
)
ORDER BY duration_years DESC, unics_id ASC
